title: Compute with Multi-Digit Numbers, Fractions, and Percents
preview: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals and fractions; then move between fraction, decimal, and percent forms.
description: Combined Module 2/3. Indiana standards 6.NS.4 and 6.RP.1. Students compute fluently with positive multi-digit decimals and fractions, then learn to translate among fraction, decimal, and percent representations of the same number.

sections.label: 2-1 Compute Multi-Digit Decimals
sections.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals in real-world problems.

sections.label: 2-2 Compute Multi-Digit Fractions
sections.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions and mixed numbers, including division of a fraction by a fraction.

sections.label: 2-3 Relate Fractions, Decimals, and Percents
sections.description: Convert between any two representations of a positive rational number — fraction, decimal, or percent.

source.name: Plug N Play
